scores.rationale: The candidate invented its own Definition of Done that directly contradicts the explicit requirements of the issue. Most glaringly, it named the protocol frames `list_sessions` and `session_list` (with `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `SessionListMessage`) instead of the specified `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` (`ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `ConversationListMessage`). It also omitted the required `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, when a store does not implement `listFor`, the candidate returns an empty list (`sessions: []`), which the ticket explicitly forbids in both its description and acceptance criteria. It also allows `limit: 0` and unbounded limits instead of enforcing 1–200, and missed the `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md` updates.
